registryNote: REGISTRY SOURCE OF TRUTH (bug f78db968). 'image'/'imageRef' (ghcr.io) is the canonical PUBLISH ref that CI pushes to. 'distributionImage' (update.askexe.com) is the customer-facing PULL-THROUGH mirror of the same GHCR repository — same bytes, same digest — and is read-only (AskExe/exe-os#592), so it can never be pushed to by hand. These are one artifact under two names, not two registries. Consumers MUST deploy by digest (immutable), never by the mutable tag.

migrations.note: Handled by the image entrypoint — no external command needed.
migrations.rollback: Restore previous CRM_IMAGE_TAG and database backup if migration is non-additive. CRM migrations must be reviewed before stack manifest publication.

stackParticipation.dataSovereignty: CRM customer/deal/contact data stays in the customer VPS Postgres/ClickHouse volumes. Updates must not reset local storage or branding config.
stackParticipation.releaseLine: v0.9 private/customer pilot; v1.0 is public-beta stable.
